rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doing or saying something in a naive, childlike, or guileless way.

example.english: He innocently asked me why adults do not have to go to school.
example.traditional: 佢天真咁問我點解大人唔使返學。
example.jyutping: keoi5 tin1 zan1 gam3 man6 ngo5 dim2 gaai2 daai6 jan4 m4 sai2 faan1 hok6

rows.note: Use this when the person looks or behaves as though they have done nothing wrong, especially when facing blame.

example.english: They looked at me innocently, as if they had nothing to do with it.
example.traditional: 佢無辜咁望住我，好似件事同佢完全冇關咁。
example.jyutping: keoi5 mou4 gu1 gam3 mong6 zyu6 ngo5 hou2 ci5 gin6 si6 tung4 keoi5 jyun4 cyun4 mou5 gwaan1 gam3

rows.note: Use this when the innocent manner specifically comes from not understanding what is happening or what is wrong.

example.english: They innocently signed the contract without knowing what they had agreed to.
example.traditional: 佢懵懵懂懂咁簽咗張合約，完全唔知自己答應咗乜。
example.jyutping: keoi5 mung2 mung2 dung2 dung2 gam3 cim1 zo2 zoeng1 hap6 joek3 jyun4 cyun4 m4 zi1 zi6 gei2 daap3 jing3 zo2 mat1
